what: Plan checks revise_rc but the helper reports total revision failure through REVISE_STATUS while exiting 0
scenario_or_breakage: All waterfall tiers fail, plan-review-loop treats revise_rc=0 as success, advances convergence or cap state, and Gate B passive summary can claim accepted findings were applied even though plan.txt was restored
suggested_fix: Parse REVISE_STATUS=ok from revise stdout or change revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh to exit nonzero on failed-*; add tests for failed-no-patch and failed-validation

what: Revise forensics still live under plan-review/round-N/revise while the publish plan disallows nested plan-review paths
scenario_or_breakage: A successful auto-apply round leaves revise/prompt.txt and output files under plan-review/round-N; design-log-publish.sh then fails closed on unexpected nested files
suggested_fix: Add UPDATED revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh to move revise forensics to DESIGN_TMPDIR/revise/round-N, or allow a constrained revise subdir in publisher; align snapshot and integration tests

what: Auto-apply inside the loop bypasses the existing post-apply validation and size-gate pipeline
scenario_or_breakage: A revised plan can skip the duplicate sweep, full-review validator, and Step 2b.5 split threshold before Gate C, so an oversized or invalid final plan can be approved
suggested_fix: Add the shared post-apply pipeline after every successful loop revision or before passive Gate B continues; test validator and Step 2b.5 execution after loop auto-apply

what: Multi-round tally overwrites root OOS and rejected artifacts each round
scenario_or_breakage: An accepted OOS item from round 1 disappears if round 2 overwrites oos-accepted-design.md with no OOS items, so Step 5b never files it
suggested_fix: Maintain cumulative loop-level OOS and rejected artifacts or merge per-round snapshots into the root artifacts before Step 4 and Step 5b; add regression coverage

what: main-agent-vote-required is left outside the auto-apply loop
scenario_or_breakage: With zero external voters, the main-agent tally can accept findings, but the proposed loop halts before revision and does not define whether to resume rounds or route to manual Gate B
suggested_fix: After main-agent tally, either call the revise helper and resume/exit the loop by the same rules, or explicitly document and test a manual Gate B exception

what: New integration harness is required but Makefile is not in the change set
scenario_or_breakage: make lint can miss test-design-multi-round-integration even though the plan makes it an acceptance check
suggested_fix: Add UPDATED: Makefile, wire test-design-multi-round-integration into a harness shard and .PHONY list, and update scripts/relevant-checks.sh if scoped checks must select it

scenario_or_breakage: The plan says complete remains and tests should keep a single-pass complete path, but the pseudocode exits as converged, cap-hit, revision-failed, panel-failed, or main-agent-vote-required
suggested_fix: Define the exact legacy-mode branch for omitted --round-cap, or remove complete from the contract and update all callers and tests
